This is a sibling status/value path: it repeats the same temporary-object setup and '%s %s' formatter at full guest address 0x7001d4dfcf, with no domain-specific operation identifiable from the body/caller. This helper checks/creates status-related values and passes the two-string format '%s %s' (0x7001d4dfcf) into a formatting/helper path. Available evidence does not distinguish its semantic role. Body: decompiled/main/main_0054.c:4297-4369. Caller: decompiled/main/main_0055.c:26773-26777.

The body looks up the SELL_CARD property and updates the associated context counters/status fields, including branches that advance the current index and notify/update through helpers. The exact key is SELL_CARD at guest address 0x7001c4bcaf and is passed to the property lookup at decompiled/main/main_0078.c:29718-29727; field accesses and branches are at :29729-29750. No callers are present in the available caller index.

The routine obtains the PlayerCard property (full guest address 0x7001c62d36), adjusts hit-zone/card flags and copies the card reference into the hit-zone context before invoking the hit-zone processing helper. The routine initializes a roster-load context, queries DEFAULT_ROSTERS (full guest address 0x7001d3d81f), invokes the live-roster pack loader when appropriate, and handles roster/stats read errors and fallback to the default loadout. Body: decompiled/main/main_0070.c:17397-17420, 17471-17483; strings at 0x7001c4b401 and 0x7001d04e5a. Caller initializes the source object before the call: decompiled/main/main_0065.c:35604-35608.

The body hashes a zero-terminated name, searches/creates a linked hash entry, stores the second argument as the entry value, and links it into the global registry. A caller supplies the name key AssetBinder (full guest address 0x7001d4bf09 in its call setup); body: decompiled/main/main_0172.c:26029-26063, 26066-26075, 26090-26129. Callers pass both key/value arguments, e.g. decompiled/main/main_0033.c:55111-55115.

The caller invokes it after setting up record storage, but evidence does not make the final metric/curve purpose precise enough for a name. Body: decompiled/main/main_0055.c:2641-2745. Caller: decompiled/main/main_0055.c:1349-1353.
